nativeValidation.reason: The implementation worker has Linux access only. The coordinator must run the recorded validation on m3-16 before native acceptance.
nativeValidation.setup: Use the commit at the recorded SHA. Run the first four commands from the native worktree root. Copy the listed probe source into the new .t3-tmp directory before running the remaining commands in the same shell.

files.purpose: Loopback Connect and local process acceptance on the native host
Native timed-out status, process group checks, and already-exited leader tests

expectedResults: uname reports Darwin arm64. All Go commands exit 0.
The output-drain probe reports one explicit exit 0 with timed_out=false. It replays the same ready output and terminal status on attach. The descendant is alive after the deadline.
A deadline against a running shell stops its process group and returns SIGKILL with timed_out=true. Server.Close stops the active group and the regression test confirms timed_out=false.
The direct cancellation test leaves the descendant alive when the group leader has exited, both before and after reaping.
